holidays.name: National Dessert Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to indulging your sweet tooth with cake, pie, ice cream, or whatever sugary masterpiece calls your name. Skipping dessert is practically considered a rule violation.
holidays.origin: Observed in the United States as an unofficial food holiday, popularized by food-celebration calendars and promoted by restaurants and bakeries. The exact founder is unclear.
holidays.funFact: The word 'dessert' comes from the French 'desservir,' meaning 'to clear the table,' since dessert was originally served after the table was cleared of the main meal.

holidays.name: National Chester Cheetah Day
holidays.description: A salute to the sunglasses-wearing, orange mascot of Cheetos, celebrated by snacking on cheesy puffs and trying not to wipe your fingers on the couch.
holidays.origin: Created by Frito-Lay fans and snack-marketing calendars to honor the mascot, who debuted in 1986 with the slogan 'It's not easy being cheesy.'
holidays.funFact: Chester Cheetah was originally voiced by Jim Cummings, who is also known for voicing Winnie the Pooh and Tigger.

holidays.name: World Standards Day
holidays.description: A day to appreciate the unglamorous heroes that make the world function: standards. From paper sizes to shipping containers to the shape of your charging plug, someone agreed on it.
holidays.origin: First celebrated in 1970 and organized by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), IEC, and ITU to honor the experts who develop international standards.
holidays.funFact: The A4 paper size comes from the ISO 216 standard, which keeps a consistent 1:√2 aspect ratio so that folding a sheet in half gives you a smaller sheet of the same proportions.

holidays.name: International E-Waste Day
holidays.description: A day to dig through your junk drawer of dead phones, tangled chargers, and ancient gadgets, and recycle them responsibly instead of letting them haunt you forever.
holidays.origin: Launched in 2018 by the WEEE Forum, an international association of electronic waste collection organizations, to raise awareness about the growing mountain of discarded electronics.
holidays.funFact: Humanity generates tens of millions of tonnes of e-waste each year, and a large share of it contains valuable materials like gold, silver, and copper that could be recovered.

holidays.name: Be Bold in Business Day
holidays.description: A day encouraging people to take risks, pitch big ideas, and stop hiding behind the safe option in the workplace, even if it means speaking up in a meeting.
holidays.origin: An informal observance popularized by entrepreneurship and business-motivation communities as a nudge to move beyond fear and play it too safe.
holidays.funFact: Many famous companies, including Airbnb, began as risky ideas that were rejected by numerous investors before becoming huge successes.
